diagnostics, added denominators, and corrections of citation.
No direction, sign, family member, arm, calibration, scale choice, missing-value rule, cohort, split
fraction, cold minimum, generalization threshold, admitted-fraction band, derived fit floor, binomial
alpha, anti-fiat guard or decision-procedure step may be changed by any amendment.
Anything in that list can change only by a new pre-registration under a new plan_sha256, sealed before
the next number is read -- the same clause v1 carried and under which this file was authored.
One further bound this plan adds to v1's: a third pre-registration MAY NOT move the admitted-fraction
bands, the generalization threshold of 1.5, the split minimum of 400 or the holdout minimum of 40
downward. Those four numbers have now survived two plans and one recorded negative result. A plan that
needs them lower is not a better plan; it is the p-hacking these files exist to prevent, arriving by
Every amendment is appended to $.amendments naming the phase it preceded. $.amendments is outside
plan_sha256_over by construction, which is exactly why the binding policy lives here, inside the hash.

guard_b_family_ablation.ablation_threshold_rule: t_ablation is the HIGHEST threshold at which the ablation admits at least as many cold coldstart_train rows as the registered shape admits. Deterministic, always exists, label-free, and volume-matched on train. Where the achievable counts are coarse, the tie is broken toward the higher threshold -- fewer admitted rows, which raises the ablation's precision and therefore makes it HARDER for the registered shape to beat. The conservative direction is chosen on purpose.
conditions: holdout_cold_lift(registered) > holdout_cold_lift(ablation), STRICTLY. A tie is a FAIL.

holdout_cold_auc(registered) > holdout_cold_auc(ablation), STRICTLY, where cold AUC is the probability that a randomly chosen consumed cold holdout candidate scores above a randomly chosen non-consumed one, ties counted as one half.
mandatory_reporting: the ablation's own admitted counts and fractions on train, eval and holdout

if the ablation ALONE clears 1.5, that must be recorded as an explicit finding -- the guard still binds on the strict comparison, but a reader is entitled to know that the shape change carries a passing lift without the family
guard_b_family_ablation.sealed_with_the_parameters: t_ablation is fitted on coldstart_train and written into the sealed parameter digest before the holdout is opened, exactly like the registered threshold
guard_b_family_ablation.what_the_ablation_is: the SAME registered shape with the family arm replaced by its neutral value: S_ablation = N + 0.0. Same calibration tables, same rows, same fail-closed rules -- family_unscoreable rows remain inadmissible in BOTH shapes, so the two share a denominator and differ only in whether F contributes its real rank-normal value or 0.0.
why_auc_as_well_as_lift: Lift is measured at a threshold, so an ablation that lands at a very different admitted
volume can post a flattering or a punishing lift for reasons that have nothing to do with
the family. AUC is threshold-free and volume-free and cannot be distorted that way.
Requiring BOTH strictly is strictly harder than requiring lift alone. It is added, not
substituted, so guard (a)'s and this guard's stated form are both honoured.
why_this_ablation_is_not_a_strawman: On the cold subpopulation S_ablation is nearly constant: every cold row with a readable
ledger shares one history atom, so the ablation's only remaining discrimination among cold
rows is the level arm. The ablation therefore measures exactly the right thing -- whether
the family beats simply preferring schema nodes -- and 'prefer schema' is a real and
tempting degenerate policy, not an invented one.
It is also the precise control for the accusation this plan invites: the ablation IS the
imputation-and-recalibration fix with no family in it. If recalibration alone carried the
result, the ablation would match the registered shape and this guard would fail.

decision_procedure: 1. Verify this file's plan_sha256 over plan_sha256_over. Any mismatch: HALT before reading anything.

2. Verify every split meets minimum_cold_candidates_per_split = 400, that the three component lists are pairwise disjoint, and that the published assignment satisfies split_protocol.assignment_rule.blindness_invariant_binding. Any failure: HALT, do not proceed on a smaller split.

3. Read coldstart_train ONLY. Build every rank calibration table. Check each core family member's registered sign on coldstart_train, whole-tail and cold; any member failing, or indeterminate for want of cold rows, is a FAIL.

4. Select the registered threshold and t_ablation by their registered label-free rules on coldstart_train. Publish feasible_threshold_count. If it is 0: HALT and record a NEGATIVE RESULT; the holdout is not opened. Write the sealed parameter digest to disk.
5. Read coldstart_eval. Verify registered signs on coldstart_eval and secondary_anchor, whole-tail and cold. A core member failing is a FAIL.
6. Check guard (d) on coldstart_train and coldstart_eval, and guard (c) on coldstart_eval. Any failure: HALT and record a NEGATIVE RESULT; the holdout is not opened.
7. Read coldstart_holdout EXACTLY ONCE, in the single pass specified at single_holdout_pass.

8. PASS requires ALL of: guard (a) holdout_cold_lift >= 1.5; guard (b) both strict comparisons against the ablation; guard (c) already cleared at step 6; guard (d) on every split including the holdout; admitted cold holdout count >= 40 and > 0; binomial p <= 0.05; and the withheld-holdout reproduction returning a byte-identical parameter digest.
9. Any other outcome is a recorded FAIL or NEGATIVE RESULT. Neither may be repaired by widening the family, adding a branch, re-drawing a split, moving a band, or re-reading the holdout.

mechanism: src/living_memory/recall_map.py:1190-1258. relevance_score sums five z-terms. Feature 0 is
level_is_schema; features 1..4 are matured-history terms. When history is unavailable
_history_features returns RELEVANCE_FEATURE_MEANS[1..4] verbatim, so those four terms are
identically zero and the score collapses to the level term alone.
Those means are a FOREIGN COHORT's raw means: they were computed on the warm ledger
organic-tail fit cohort, every member of which had history. Substituting them into a
cold-inclusive population is not a neutral act, and that is the whole defect.

what_the_defect_actually_is.diagnosis: arithmetic SCALE, not signal, and not imputation

reading: A cold row must make up 5.6238 of history z using a family arm whose entire
median-to-p95 range is 0.9108. The handicap is 6.17 TIMES the family's ordinary
dynamic range. No threshold can arbitrate between two quantities that differ by
that factor: the ordering of the pooled population is the ordering by history
alone, up to a rounding error contributed by the family.

why_the_family_scale_is_so_narrow: The family arm is a sum of winsorize-then-standardize z-terms. Standardizing divides by
a standard deviation, and for heavy-tailed retrieval scores that standard deviation is
set by the tail, not by the bulk. p1/p99 winsorization per member does not fix it,
because the composite's heaviness comes from rows extreme on several members at once
and because 1% of rows still pass through at full magnitude.
The published cold family_z distribution is the signature of exactly this: p95 = +0.4607
but p99 = +9.46. Ninety-five percent of the cold population is compressed into a band
under one z wide while the top percentile is twenty times wider.
So the family's RANK information was intact -- that is why its lift was 1.83 -- while its
ARITHMETIC magnitude was a rounding error against the history arm. v1 measured real
discrimination and then had no shape that could spend it.

v1_own_words: 'The family is not too weak at the top: its best cold row reaches +10.16, well past the
+4.4703 the prereg registered as the target. It is too weak in the MIDDLE: the median cold
row sits at -0.45 and the 95th percentile at +0.46, so only 41 of 1233 cold rows (3.3%)
reach the schema target and 37 (3.0%) reach the trace target.'
why_a_single_additive_sum_welds_the_two_: Because the history arm dominates the sum by a factor of about six, a descending threshold
sweep orders the pooled population essentially by history. Cold rows are a solid block at
the bottom of that order. A threshold therefore admits nearly every warm row before it
admits any material number of cold rows, and the cold and overall admitted fractions move
as one quantity rather than two.
That is not a metaphor; it is the measured frontier. policy.json#coldstart_revision.
overall 0.754237 at the cold floor and cold 0.030008 at the overall ceiling.

statistic_changed_and_why.v1: consumed-minus-nonconsumed mean difference on the winsorized-and-standardized values the v1 scorer consumed
statistic_changed_and_why.v2: consumed-minus-nonconsumed mean difference on the rank_uniform_centered values THIS scorer consumes
what_that_buys: The mean difference of rank-uniform values between two groups is an affine function of the
Mann-Whitney U statistic. So the check becomes exactly 'does this member rank consumed rows
above non-consumed rows', which is invariant to every monotone re-expression of the member.
v1's raw-scale mean difference was vulnerable to the same heavy-tail distortion that
produced the p95 0.4607 / p99 9.46 spike and killed its scorer: a handful of extreme rows
could set the sign. This statistic cannot be moved by a handful of extreme rows.
The registered SIGNS are unchanged. Only the estimator of the sign is made robust, and it is
made robust in the direction that is harder to pass by accident, not easier.

feasibility_argument.claim: the cold admitted-fraction band [0.05, 0.25] and the overall admitted-fraction band [0.10, 0.30] are JOINTLY satisfiable by a single threshold under this scorer shape, and the argument for that is structural -- it follows from the transform, not from any number the enlarged population will produce

consequences.independent_of: the cold share q, the schema share, the population size, and every number the sibling coldstart-population-widen will publish

proof: The block occupies fitting positions 1..qn and its midrank fraction is (0 + qn/2)/n = q/2.
Midranks preserve the sum of ranks, so the remaining (1-q)n rows have mean rank fraction
Centering subtracts 0.5 from both. The difference is (1+q)/2 - q/2 = 1/2, independent of q.
step_1_the_exact_tie_block_identity.statement: on a midrank rank_uniform_centered scale, if the lowest-valued rows form a tie block of mass q, that block's value is exactly q/2 - 0.5 and the mean value of every row above it is exactly q/2. The gap between them is exactly 1/2, for EVERY q.
why_it_applies_here: Every cold row with a readable ledger has M = C = K = 0, hence an identical four-term
composite of -3.6135, hence a single tie block at the very bottom of the history arm.
Cold rows whose ledger is unreadable form a second block, at the composite value 0.0,
which sits ABOVE the -3.6135 block, so the bound below is conservative for them.

reading: The family is not touched. Not one member is added, not one sign is changed, not one
cold row's family RANK moves. What moves is the bar: from '+2.2026 on a scale whose
p95 is +0.4607' to '+0.25 to +0.50 on a scale whose p69 is +0.50'. The share of cold
rows that can clear it grows by an order of magnitude purely because the two
quantities are finally measured in the same units.

step_2_what_a_cold_row_now_has_to_do.statement: because F is rank-normal on the fitting split by construction, the family percentile a cold row must reach to tie a mean-placed warm row is a fixed, computable number

level_association: neutral (cold and warm rows level-distributed alike)
grid.p_s_anchor_note: 0.26434558 is RELEVANCE_FEATURE_MEANS[0], the foreign warm cohort's schema share; 0.10 is included because the cold-inclusive population's schema share is unknown at registration and the model must not depend on it
grid.q_anchor_note: 0.217691 is v1's measured coldstart_train cold_candidate_share, quoted from policy.json#coldstart_revision.dataset.train_set, which is already-published v1 data and not a number from the enlarged population

model: F is exactly N(0,1) on the pooled fitting split -- this is enforced by the transform and is
not an assumption about the data. Split it into cold and warm at a mean separation delta,
H is rank-uniform: the cold block sits at q/2 - 0.5, the warm rows are uniform on
(q - 0.5, 0.5]. L is the two-point rank-uniform image of a binary at schema share p_s.
N = (L + H)/2, score = N + F, and the cold and overall admitted fractions are read off as
functions of a single threshold t.
The model assumes NO relationship between any arm and the consumption label. That is the
correct model for this question: an admitted-FRACTION band is about volume, not about
discrimination, so assuming zero signal is the conservative choice.
step_3_the_frontier_under_a_null_model.reproducibility: the model is fully specified above and is 30 lines of arithmetic. It reads no dataset. Anyone may recompute every number in this section from the formulas and the grid alone.

result.criterion: a cell is FEASIBLE if some single threshold t puts the overall admitted fraction in [0.10, 0.30] and the cold admitted fraction in [0.05, 0.25] at the same time

the_single_infeasible_cell.reading: a thin cold population AND a half-sigma family deficit for cold rows AND every cold row non-schema, all at once. Named here rather than hidden; see limitations.the_corner_where_this_plan_fails.

reading: v1 was short of its cold floor by a factor of 1.47 at the ceiling and had zero feasible
thresholds. This shape is modelled to clear the same floor by a factor of 3.5, and the
worst cell in a 60-cell sweep still clears it. That is the difference between a plan
with a margin and a plan that was never going to work.

why_the_model_is_legitimate_here_and_was: A normal model would have been worthless applied to v1's shape, because v1's family
composite was not remotely normal -- p95 +0.4607 against p99 +9.46. Any Gaussian
approximation would have declared v1 feasible and been wrong.
Under this shape the normality is created by the transform rather than assumed of the data.
That is the difference between a model of the population and a model of the arithmetic, and
only the second kind can be trusted before the population is read.

step_4_the_two_fractions_are_no_longer_w: Under v1 the cold rows were a solid block at the bottom of a score ordering that the history
arm dominated six to one, so the threshold could not move one fraction without dragging the
other: at cold 0.0503 overall was 0.754237, at overall 0.30 cold was 0.030008.
Under this shape the entire node-intrinsic block spans one unit while the family arm alone
spans six, so the score ordering is family-dominated and the cold and warm score distributions
OVERLAP rather than stacking. A threshold sweeping through the overlap trades the two
fractions continuously instead of moving them together, which is exactly what a non-empty
joint window means. The measured width of that window on the grid is 0.3478 score units at
its narrowest and 0.5608 at the no-separation cell.
what_the_neutral_rule_does_not_do: The missing-value rule registered below -- an unreadable arm contributes its calibrated
scale's neutral value instead of RELEVANCE_FEATURE_MEANS[1..4] -- is NOT what makes the bands
satisfiable, and this file does not claim that it is.
v1 already measured that repair in isolation, at policy.json#coldstart_revision.
history_arm_sensitivity, and it moved cold admission by one row out of 1233 and left
feasible_threshold_count at 0. The reason is recorded there too: on a complete ledger the
live reader returns known(matured = 0), not unavailable, so the unreadable branch is taken by
The rule is registered because it is CORRECT -- a foreign cohort's raw means are not a neutral
value on this population, and the live path must not fabricate evidence for a row whose ledger
genuinely cannot be read -- and because leaving a known-wrong constant in a scorer being
rewritten would be indefensible. The count of rows on which it fires must be REPORTED on every
split, and this plan pre-registers the expectation that the count will be small.
The repair is carried by the rank calibration alone. Saying so here, before the fit, is what
stops a later reader from crediting the wrong mechanism for whatever the holdout returns.

It is not a restatement of the node. Two different queries give the same node different values,

the_objection_is_correct_and_does_not_ap: v1 was right that on an additive z-scale, neutral IS mean substitution -- there is no third
option. Its mistake was concluding that mean substitution is therefore always the same act.
It is not. What matters is WHOSE mean, measured on WHICH population.
The banned substitution imputes RELEVANCE_FEATURE_MEANS[1..4], a foreign warm cohort's raw
means, onto a cold-inclusive population. Its effect there is not neutral: it places the row
at raw composite 0.0, roughly 2.0 z below the realized warm median of +2.0103 on the
The registered substitution imputes the arm's OWN median on the fitting split, by
construction, because rank_uniform_centered is centered at that median. Neutral means neutral
on the population the scorer will actually meet.
So both are 'imputation', and the difference between them is the entire parent goal: replacing
the train-mean placeholder is not the same as removing imputation, and no additive scorer can
remove it. This plan makes the imputed value honest instead of pretending it is absent.

out_of_sample_and_live_application.atoms: every fitting value whose multiplicity is at least 0.5% of the fitting rows is published as an EXACT (value, u) pair and is matched by equality before any interpolation. rank_normal.formula: F(v) = clip(Phi_inverse(clip(u(v) + 0.5, 1/(2n), 1 - 1/(2n))), -3.0, +3.0), with u from the same construction as above
rank_normal.why_guaranteed: these are properties of the transform, not of the data. Whatever shape the family composite has -- including the p95 0.4607 / p99 9.46 spike v1 measured -- its rank-normal image has exactly these percentiles on the fitting split.

rank_uniform_centered.formula: u(v) = (A(v) + M(v)/2) / n - 0.5, where n is the number of fitting rows on which the arm is readable, A(v) = #{fitting values strictly below v} and M(v) = #{fitting values exactly equal to v}
rank_uniform_centered.neutral_is_the_median: u is centered at the fitting sample's median by construction, so 0.0 means 'this arm places the row where half the population sits' -- which is what 'no information' has to mean on a calibrated scale
rank_uniform_centered.ties: MIDRANK. Every fitting row sharing a value receives the same u, equal to the midpoint of the block that value occupies.

reason: A cold node cannot acquire delivery history at candidate time, and it cannot change its
level. Whatever those two arms say about it, it cannot answer. An arm a row cannot answer
must be able to REORDER rows but must not be able to put a row out of reach: that is the
arithmetic form of 'history informs, history does not gate', and breaking the
delivery -> history -> selection -> delivery loop is the root goal's stated purpose.
The candidate-time family is the opposite kind of evidence. It is what THIS retrieval
found about this node for THIS query -- evidence the row owns and can differ on. It is
therefore allowed to reach as far as the evidence warrants, and gets a normal-tailed
scale whose 99th percentile is +2.3263 and whose registered clip is +3.
This asymmetry is a pre-registered SCALE choice, fixed before any number from the
population was read, and derived from the stated principle above. It is not a coefficient
and it is not fitted. It is stated plainly here rather than buried, because a reviewer is
entitled to read it as a weight in disguise and judge the justification on its merits.

what_is_carried_over_unchanged_and_why.cold_candidate_definition: matured == 0, identical to v1, still a reporting and split-audit partition only and never a scorer input
what_is_carried_over_unchanged_and_why.family_member_set_and_signs: the four core members and their registered signs are carried verbatim; they passed on train and on eval, whole-tail and cold, and there is no licence to re-open a constraint that held
what_is_carried_over_unchanged_and_why.generalization_threshold: holdout_cold_lift >= 1.5, identical to v1, not moved
what_is_carried_over_unchanged_and_why.minimum_cold_candidates_per_split: 400, identical to v1. v1 missed it by 27 on the holdout. Lowering a bar after missing it is p-hacking; the bar stays and the population moves.
what_is_carried_over_unchanged_and_why.single_holdout_read: holdout_evaluations must equal 1, identical to v1

what_this_plan_changes: scorer_shape: the sum is taken over RANK-CALIBRATED arms rather than over eight raw z-terms
on a foreign cohort's scale. This is the only substantive change and it is the one v1's own
missing_value_rule: an unreadable arm contributes its own calibrated scale's neutral value
instead of RELEVANCE_FEATURE_MEANS[1..4]. Registered for correctness and for the live path;
this plan does NOT claim it carries the repair -- see feasibility_argument.what_the_neutral
graph_score: promoted from conditional to permanently EXCLUDED, because v1's registered
conditional test was run and confirmed the flip. A decided question is not re-opened.
direction check statistic: taken on the rank-calibrated values, which makes it an affine
function of the Mann-Whitney U rather than a raw-scale mean difference.
anti_fiat_guards: three new binding conditions (family ablation, warm non-degradation, and
the pre-holdout empirical feasibility gate) that v1 did not carry.
supersedes.which_failure_this_plan_addresses: admitted_fraction_band. The split minimum is NOT addressed here and is NOT moved; the sibling coldstart-population-widen enlarges the population instead.

admitted_fraction_bands.applies_to: coldstart_train, coldstart_eval and coldstart_holdout, each independently
admitted_fraction_bands.denominator: candidates eligible after the unchanged ballast filter
why_a_ceiling_is_required: The live selector admits 1.51-1.89% of candidates against a policy calibrated for 20%. A
revision that 'fixes' that by admitting everything is not a fix -- it is the map turning
into noise, which the root goal names as the one thing the repair must not do.
The cold ceiling is the tighter of the two because that is where the flooding risk sits:
the live residual is predominantly cold, so an unbounded cold admission rate would dominate
why_not_relaxed: These are the exact bands v1's shape could not satisfy jointly. Relaxing either one would
convert a shape failure into a bookkeeping victory and would make this file worthless.
The claim of this plan is falsifiable precisely because the bands did not move: v1 got
overall 0.754237 at the cold floor and cold 0.030008 at the overall ceiling, and v2 must
get both inside the band at one threshold or record a second negative result.

calibration_checked_at_v1_registration: Once about 100 cold rows are admitted, lift >= 1.50 is the binding condition at every plausible base rate.
Below that the binomial binds and demands a proportionally larger effect: at the floor of 40 admitted rows it requires lift 2.50 at a 0.05 base rate, 2.00 at 0.10, 1.83 at 0.15 and 1.62 at 0.20.

alpha = 0.01 was considered and REJECTED as over-constraining: at a 0.05 base rate it would demand 427 admitted cold holdout rows before lift 1.50 could clear it, which the cold admitted-fraction ceiling could forbid outright.
binomial_guard.role: small-sample guard, so the lift cannot be met by luck on a handful of admitted rows
binomial_guard.test: one-sided exact binomial: P(X >= observed consumed | n = admitted cold holdout candidates, p = cold holdout base rate) <= alpha

companion_conditions.minimum_cold_admitted_on_holdout_reason: the parent contract requires holdout cold admission strictly greater than zero; a bar of one row is decided by luck, so the registered floor is 40 and the strictly-positive requirement is subsumed by it. Unchanged from v1.

derived_fit_floor.checked_against_the_feasibility_model: the model clears the derived fit floor in 59 of 60 grid cells; the one exception is named at feasibility_argument.step_3_the_frontier_under_a_null_model.result.the_single_infeasible_cell and at limitations.the_corner_where_this_plan_fails
derived_fit_floor.what_it_is: the cold admitted fraction the THRESHOLD-SELECTION RULE targets on train, so that a holdout sitting exactly at the registered split minimum can still deliver the 40 admitted cold rows the binomial guard needs
derived_fit_floor.what_it_is_not: it is NOT a change to the cold verdict band, which stays [0.05, 0.25]. A split that admits 0.06 of its cold rows passes the band. The fit merely aims higher so that the two registered floors are mutually reachable.
why_v1_needed_this_and_did_not_have_it: v1 registered a cold floor of 0.05, a split minimum of 400 and a holdout minimum of 40
admitted cold rows, and never checked them against each other. 0.05 * 400 = 20, which is
half of 40. The three numbers were not jointly satisfiable at the registered split minimum
and nothing in v1 said so.
This is a small thing next to the shape failure, but it is the same species of error:
registering constraints without computing whether they can hold at once.

verdict_rule.generalization_threshold_not_moved: 1.5 is v1's number, carried EXACTLY. v1's anchor stands: the frozen policy's own transfer lift on its disjoint organic eval arm is 1.6138, and 1.50 sits just under it. v1's eval measurement of 1.8312 on cold rows is NOT a reason to raise it and NOT a reason to lower it; a threshold that moves after a related number is seen is not a threshold.
verdict_rule.generalization_threshold_quantity: holdout_cold_lift = (consumed among admitted cold holdout candidates / admitted cold holdout candidates) divided by (consumed cold holdout candidates / cold holdout candidates)
negative_result_is_a_legitimate_outcome: If no single threshold satisfies the bands, or a registered sign fails on the cold
subpopulation, or the family fails to beat its own ablation, the correct output is a recorded
negative result naming which condition failed and by how much.
v1 produced exactly such a result and it is the reason this plan could be written at all: it
located the defect in the shape rather than in the signal. A second negative result under a
shape with a published feasibility argument would be worth as much again, because it would
refute the argument on the page and say something new about the population.
What is NOT legitimate is a third pre-registration that finally moves a band, a minimum or the
generalization threshold. Those numbers have now survived two plans and are load-bearing.

threshold_rule.if_no_such_threshold_exists: HALT. feasible_threshold_count is 0 and the outcome is a recorded NEGATIVE RESULT. The holdout is not opened. No band is widened, no member added, no branch introduced, no split re-drawn.
threshold_rule.published: feasible_threshold_count on coldstart_train and on coldstart_eval must both be published, whatever the verdict, so the frontier is auditable the way v1's was
threshold_rule.rule: sweep candidate thresholds over the distinct coldstart_train scores in DESCENDING order and take the FIRST (highest) threshold at which the overall admitted fraction on coldstart_train lies in [0.10, 0.30] AND the cold admitted fraction on coldstart_train lies in [0.10, 0.25]. Ties in score are resolved by admitting all rows at or above the threshold.
threshold_rule.why_highest: the highest qualifying threshold is the smallest admission consistent with the registered floors, which is the conservative end of the band and the one that least risks turning the map into noise
threshold_rule.why_this_is_label_free: both quantities are admitted FRACTIONS -- ratios of counts of rows above a score -- and neither reads a consumption outcome. Coldness is a property of the ledger, not of the label. Combined with rank calibrations that also read no label, NOTHING in this scorer is fitted on labels, which is strictly stronger than v1.
